description: Named ordinary panel gestures. Read the current scope screen; numeric settings and menu context are not inferred.

controls.label: F1
controls.description: Activate F1 in the displayed ordinary menu. Inspect the screen first; do not use from maintenance or save menus.

controls.label: F2
controls.description: Activate F2 in the displayed ordinary menu. Inspect the screen first; do not use from maintenance or save menus.

controls.label: F3
controls.description: Activate F3 in the displayed ordinary menu. Inspect the screen first; do not use from maintenance or save menus.

controls.label: F4
controls.description: Activate F4 in the displayed ordinary menu. Inspect the screen first; do not use from maintenance or save menus.

controls.label: F5
controls.description: Activate F5 in the displayed ordinary menu. Inspect the screen first; do not use from maintenance or save menus.

controls.label: Select left
controls.description: Turn the multifunction control left in the displayed ordinary menu; the selected function depends on that menu.

controls.label: Select right
controls.description: Turn the multifunction control right in the displayed ordinary menu; the selected function depends on that menu.

controls.label: Select press
controls.description: Press the multifunction control in the displayed ordinary menu; inspect the current selection first.

controls.label: Measure
controls.description: Open the measurement menu.

controls.label: Acquire
controls.description: Open acquisition settings.

controls.label: Cursor
controls.description: Open cursor controls.

controls.label: Display
controls.description: Open display settings.

controls.label: Autoset
controls.description: Request automatic signal setup. This can change several scope settings; inspect the resulting screen.

controls.label: Single
controls.description: Request a single acquisition sequence; verify the displayed trigger and acquisition state.

controls.label: Math
controls.description: Open math and FFT controls; this does not extract waveform data.

controls.label: CH1 menu
controls.description: Press CH1. Depending on the current channel/menu state, this can open its menu or change its visibility.

controls.label: Position −
controls.description: Request negative CH1 vertical-position steps; verify direction and size on this scope.

controls.label: Position +
controls.description: Request positive CH1 vertical-position steps; verify direction and size on this scope.

controls.label: Position zero
controls.description: Press the CH1 position knob to request its zero position.

controls.label: V/div −
controls.description: Request negative CH1 scale steps; the current range and probe factor must be read from the screen.

controls.label: V/div +
controls.description: Request positive CH1 scale steps; the current range and probe factor must be read from the screen.

controls.label: CH2 menu
controls.description: Press CH2. Depending on the current channel/menu state, this can open its menu or change its visibility.

controls.label: Position −
controls.description: Request negative CH2 vertical-position steps; verify direction and size on this scope.

controls.label: Position +
controls.description: Request positive CH2 vertical-position steps; verify direction and size on this scope.

controls.label: Position zero
controls.description: Press the CH2 position knob to request its zero position.

controls.label: V/div −
controls.description: Request negative CH2 scale steps; the current range and probe factor must be read from the screen.

controls.label: V/div +
controls.description: Request positive CH2 scale steps; the current range and probe factor must be read from the screen.

controls.label: Horizontal menu
controls.description: Open horizontal and window settings.

controls.label: Position −
controls.description: Request negative horizontal-position steps. Sources differ on visual direction; verify on the screen.

controls.label: Position +
controls.description: Request positive horizontal-position steps. Sources differ on visual direction; verify on the screen.

controls.label: Position zero
controls.description: Press the horizontal-position knob to request its zero position.

controls.label: Time/div −
controls.description: Request negative timebase steps; absolute time/div must be verified on the scope display.

controls.label: Time/div +
controls.description: Request positive timebase steps; absolute time/div must be verified on the scope display.

controls.label: Trigger menu
controls.description: Open trigger settings. Soft-key meanings depend on the current trigger type.

controls.label: Level −
controls.description: Request negative trigger-level steps; this does not specify an absolute voltage.

controls.label: Level +
controls.description: Request positive trigger-level steps; this does not specify an absolute voltage.

controls.label: Level knob press
controls.description: Press the trigger-level knob and verify the resulting level on screen.

controls.label: Set to 50%
controls.description: Request trigger level at 50% of the signal; verify the actual displayed level.

controls.label: Force trigger
controls.description: Request a force trigger on the oscilloscope; inspect its acquisition state.
